chapter: Early 1930s: Bessie Smith, Rex Stewart and the Harlem scene
title: The Rex Stewart band tours and breaks up
summary: The band lasted a year or two, toured Baltimore and Washington with Chauncey Houghton, then broke up amid transportation and booking troubles.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, let's just finish off with Rex. How long did this last with Rex Stewart?
Oh, about a year or two.

Because it was...Chauncey Houghton from Baltimore later joined the band, and we went on a tour. We played the Lafayette, then we went on tour to Baltimore, Washington, D.C., places like that. Then the band broke up.
Why did it break up? It couldn't get any more bookings?
I don't remember. I think Rex just had it... You know, bands are a lot of problems, and transportation, you know... And we had started to see it good, but...
